description:
Shelters for Earthquake, Iraq, 12 November 2017 (EQ20171112IRQ): 1,526 features merged from 1 source layer. Point layers with shelter or camp columns, or whose names mention camps, shelters, IDPs, or settlements. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Buildings Damage Assessment & Related Density North of  Sarpol-e-Zahab County, Iran](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/buildings-damage-assessment-related-density-north-of-sarpol-e-zahab-county-iran-2737)
- [Damage Assessment of Koeeke Hasan Town and Surroundings, Kermanshah, Iran](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-of-koeeke-hasan-town-and-surroundings-kermanshah-iran-2736)
- [Damaged structures and related density map in Sarpol-e-Zahab, Kermanshah, Iran](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damaged-structures-and-related-density-map-in-sarpol-e-zahab-kermanshah-iran-2732)
- [Shelters and people gathering sites in Sarpol-e-Zahab, Kermanshah, Iran](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/shelters-and-people-gathering-sites-in-sarpol-e-zahab-kermanshah-iran-2729)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Worldview-1; 2 = Worldview-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = Komsat-2; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleadies; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `Sensor_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Date
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `Confidence_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `Field_Validation_label`.

table:columns.name: CampStatusID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Closed / Relocated; 1 = Open (Operational); 2 = Planned / Under Construction; 9 = Camp Destroyed. The decoded text is in `CampStatusID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 55 = MF; 66 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: CampStatusID_label
table:columns.description: `CampStatusID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Confidence_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Confidence_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Field_Validation_label
table:columns.description: `Field_Validation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Sensor_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
